description: This source file defines the SecurityIRClient class, which extends AwsClient, for interacting with the AWS Security Incident Response service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to case management, memberships, attachments, comments, tags, and updates within the security incident response system.

classes.name: SecurityIRClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with AWS Security Incident Response service, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: batchGetMemberAccountDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details for multiple member accounts.

methods.description: Creates a new security incident case.

methods.name: createCaseComment
methods.description: Adds a comment to a case.

methods.name: getCase
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific case.

methods.name: getCaseAttachmentDownloadUrl
methods.description: Gets the download URL for a case attachment.

methods.description: Updates the status of a case.
